Blaubleim: But hey, that’s why we are talking, right? We are gonna try to make some progress in this direction.
Blaubleim: Let’s move to the next thing.
Blaubleim: You didn’t like the fact that me and your mom communicated with each other, right?
You: Yes! Why would you tell her that I stopped taking my pills?! That only made her more annoying and overprotective!
Blaubleim: I had no intention of incurring your displeasure, I assure you.
Blaubleim: The only thing I wanted to achieve was to make sure that you are doing all right.
Blaubleim: My talk with your mom revealed more facts, like you losing your job and girlfriend.
You: …
Blaubleim: Frankly speaking, when your mom said that she wants to make an appointment for you I immediately told her that it was a good idea.
You: !
Blaubleim: Better safe than sorry son! It’s only 300$, really, and it could save you some trouble. I know it might be hard to ask for help. Especially with problems of such nature.
Blaubleim: Oh my! I was talking for so long there, haha!
Blaubleim: So tell me Anon, what did you feel when she told you that I called her?
